name: Hesperid Nymph
text: As a guardian of sunsets and liminal spaces, you're a rarity among nymphs. You have an affinity with animals that are active during twilight. Your bonded item is equally unique, representing your relationship with sunsets and the passage of time, rather than the literal sun. Once per day, you can store a non-magical object of 5 Bulk or less by weaving it into a golden apple of light as a 3-action activity. The apple is an object with light Bulk. The object reverts to its original state when this ability is used to store a new object, when you Dismiss the effect, or a creature touching the item Interacts to end the effect. It appears in the hand or hands of someone holding the apple if possible, or in the nearest unoccupied space if it isn't being held or is too large to hold.
